question: Can you plot the area of each overpass using a GSD of 0.1?
final_answer_preview:
The image dimensions are **800x800 pixels**. Using a Ground Sample Distance (GSD) of 0.1 meters per pixel, the area covered by the image is calculated as:

$$
\text{Area} = \text{width} \times \text{height} \times (\text{GSD})^2 = 800 \times 800 \times (0.1)^2 = 6400 \, \text{square meters}
$$

**Answer:** The area of the overpass is **6400 square meters**.
